purpose: PLAN.md M6 decision 7: the NLI model's reliability on wording pairs outside the 40-entry fixture; M9's baseline. Labels were written by hand on 2026-10-17, before the model scored any pair, and are never revised to match model output (CLAUDE.md, ML discipline).
usage: Each pair is scored exactly as the fairness checker scores a wording candidate: entailment in both directions at the configured threshold. Every pair keeps its numbers identical, because only such pairs ever reach the model.

labels.equivalent: the same question is asked: a fair wording variant
labels.changed_quantity: a different quantity is asked for
labels.changed_units: the answer is asked for in different units
labels.constraint: a condition is added or removed
labels.reversed_relationship: a relationship or direction is reversed
